parsed.doc_summary: SF.gov Rent Board notice that S.F. Admin. Code § 37.10C, banning sale or use of algorithmic rent-setting devices, took effect October 14, 2024.

rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices
rules.requirement: Landlords and vendors may not sell or use algorithmic devices (software using nonpublic competitor rental data) to recommend rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units. A tenant or the City Attorney can sue over violations.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor rental data
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of such algorithmic devices and allows a tenant or the City Attorney to bring a civil action if they believe an entity is in violation of the law.
rules.effective_date_note: Per SF.gov: went into effect October 14, 2024.
rules.penalty: Civil action by a tenant or the City Attorney
